row.title: glm empty replies kept failing after the textOf fix; the log now says why
row.body: 2026-11-26 after PR 2449: orchestrator runs no longer die on the neuron cap, but 10 of 19 glm-4.7-flash calls still read 'empty reply'. textOf now also reads choices[0].message.reasoning_content (the JSON gate rejects junk), and the empty-reply reason names the response keys, finish_reason and message fields so the cause is read from airouter_calls. Next failure seen: orchestrator step 'FIND text is not in the file'.

title: glm empty replies kept failing after the textOf fix; the log now says why
